visualObservations.body: Human woman, two arms and two legs, athletic but ordinary proportions; medium warm olive/tan skin; dark brown tied ponytail with loose front strands; uncovered neutral determined face.
visualObservations.costume: White sleeveless Aperture tank with pale blue-grey edge/underlayer, grey-blue wrap/band around waist; orange jumpsuit upper half lowered and sleeves tied at waist, orange trousers rolled below knees; no Portal 1 zipped torso suit.
visualObservations.boots: White Long Fall Boots with black toe/sole, open dark calf section and black straps, curved black rear spring/brace descending behind heel; not generic armoured shin greaves.
visualObservations.device: Full Chell device turnaround not established. Equipment solo uses the much better documented pair of Long Fall Boots. Device if present is subordinate and limited to the white/black shell and three black prongs supported by official Portal 2 screenshots, without co-op paint or speculative internals.
visualObservations.world: Aperture Portal 2 uses modular panels, cyan dotted indicators, decaying test chambers, cylindrical elevator tubes, steel service framework and red thermal beams. New layouts are canon-inspired compositions, not reproduced game screenshots.

observations: Broad Portal 2 ponytail, white upper garment and orange waist-tied jumpsuit are present.
